title: feat: add Grok Imagine Video 1.5 Lite (xAI direct, OpenRouter fallback)
author: tomdacatto
pr_body_excerpt:
Fixes #16646

- Adds `x-ai/grok-imagine-video-1.5-lite`, xAI's faster, cheaper distilled Video 1.5 (released 2026-10-01): no aliases, paid-only, `priceMultiplier` 1, text or start-image input, 1-15 s, 480p / 720p (default) / 1080p. Video only: audio output is not advertised because neither xAI nor OpenRouter documents it for Lite.
- Primary route is xAI's direct video API (`grok-imagine-video-1.5-lite`, existing `XAI_API_KEY`). New `callXaiVideoAPI` submits to `POST /v1/videos/generations`, polls `GET /v1/videos/{id}`, downloads the temporary URL, and bills the duration xAI reports. An image-to-video request omits `aspect_ratio` (xAI would stretch the frame). A video xAI filters by moderation is rejected as `content_policy_violation`.
- Fallback `x-ai/grok-imagine-video-1.5-lite:openrouter` reuses the OpenRouter Grok handler at the same rates plus the 5.5% credit fee.
- Cost, per [docs.x.ai](https://docs.x.ai/developers/models) (OpenRouter lists the same SKUs): $0.02 / $0.03 / $0.14 per second at 480p / 720p / 1080p, plus $0.01 per start-frame image.

## Verification

- Local Cloudflare Workers: 82 focused handler, fallback, registry and frame-validation tests pass; `npm run typecheck` passes.
- Real xAI and OpenRouter direct probes pass. Authenticated local Gen passes text-to-video at 480p/720p/1080p on both primary and forced fallback, plus start-frame input at 480p and `/v1/images/generations` MP4 output. Forced failure was injected only in untracked build output, then restored.
- Disconnect/rejoin and completed-cache replay pass on primary and fallback. Ten generated clips produce ten billed staging events; the 0.91 Pollen total matches the local wallet debit. Fallback costs include 5.5%, while public prices stay unchanged. No missing-conversion warnings.
- Both catalogs expose the canonical model and hide the fallback. No paid balance returns 402; zero duration, unsupported resolution and direct fallback selection return 400.
- Observed behavior: the shared Gro

gist.headline: A little more motion
gist.blurb: Grok Imagine Video 1.5 Lite joins the video garden. Give it a prompt or a starting image, and it grows a clip up to 15 seconds long.
gist.summary: Adds paid-only `x-ai/grok-imagine-video-1.5-lite` for text-to-video and start-image-to-video clips of 1–15 seconds at 480p, 720p, or 1080p, routed through xAI directly with an OpenRouter fallback.
gist.impact: Developers get a video-only model with a 720p default; pricing is $0.02, $0.03, or $0.14 per second by resolution, plus $0.01 for a start image and a 5.5% credit fee on fallback requests.

Polli, wearing a tiny director's beret, guides the frames beside a CRT monitor robot; lime-green code-plants and flowers connect the video-generation theme to the pollinations garden.
